statement: For the explicit 4x5 KG state R and EVERY 2-block-positive witness W invariant under the source's effective local T^2, define Q_W(T)=Tr[W (I tensor T) R (I tensor T)^*] on 5x5 matrices T, and let L_W be its Hermitian matrix in vec(T). Then L_W has at most one negative eigenvalue. If Tr(W R)<0, it has exactly one; its negative eigenspace is in the diagonal-filter sector and its eigenvector is a diagonal 5x5 matrix with every diagonal entry nonzero, hence rank 5. This is a certified-witness SEARCH DIAGNOSTIC for this one source/symmetry, not a global 4x4 claim or evidence that the target is false.
source_and_invariance: R=[A]+[B]+[D]+3([C]+[E]+[23]+[30]+[32]+[04]) with A=00+11+22, B=01+12, D=10-21, C=02+34, E=20+33; trace31. Exact rational PSD/PPT/range checks are in frontier-20261029-kg45-source-check.py SHA256 8a9f5ba28a8c90e7ccc197e13b39754552c8c3ee38f76e2fab5bc31e69be40b2. The effective source torus has Alice exponents f=(0,delta,2delta,xi) and Bob exponents g=(0,-delta,-2delta,2delta-xi,-2delta-xi); each source ket is an eigenvector. If W shares the invariance, Q_W(U_B T U_B^*)=Q_W(T), using source invariance and cyclicity of trace.
link_sectors: Under T -> U_B T U_B^*, the zero character consists of the five diagonal matrix units E_00,...,E_44. Exactly two nonzero characters have multiplicity two, with supports {(0,1),(1,2)} and {(1,0),(2,1)}; all sixteen other nonzero characters are singletons. The Hermitian matrix L_W is block diagonal by these characters. Every matrix in any nonzero sector has rank at most two; (I tensor T)R(I tensor T)^* then has Bob support dimension at most two, hence Schmidt number <=2. Since W is 2-block positive, Q_W(T)>=0 there. Thus every nonzero-character block of L_W is PSD.
diagonal_sector: For each j=0,...,4, every diagonal T with T_jj=0 is a local filter of the coordinate cut R_j=(I tensor (I-[j]))R(I tensor (I-[j])). Each R_j has an exact SR<=2 decomposition. For j=0,1,2 all original nine source generators become SR<=2. For j=3 use z^4=1, q_z=z A+B-z^2 D-z^3|20>, with row 2=z*row 1, giving R_3=(1/4)sum_z[q_z]+2[20]+3([C]+[30]+[32]+[04]). For j=4 use q'_z=z A+z^2 B-D+z^3|02>, with column 2=z*column 1, giving R_4=(1/4)sum_z[q'_z]+2[02]+3([E]+[23]+[30]+[32]). Hence Q_W(T)>=0 on each coordinate hyperplane of diagonal T. The 5x5 zero-character block has all principal 4x4 submatrices PSD, so by interlacing it has at most one negative eigenvalue; if one exists, an associated eigenvector cannot have a zero coordinate. Q_W(I)=Tr(W R)<0 implies existence of exactly one.
crucial_limit: A singular 5x5 filter need not have a zero diagonal: I_5-(1/5)J_5 is rank 4 with every diagonal entry 4/5. Consequently the diagonal negative eigenvector being full-rank and all nonzero sectors being PSD DO NOT prove L_W is 4-block positive. A rank-4 negative filter could combine characters. The index>=2 sufficient shortcut in the filter-lift bridge cannot succeed with a T^2-invariant witness for this source; breaking witness symmetry or exhibiting a negative singular filter remains possible.

exact_check.observed: Integer/Gaussian arithmetic checks all source ket weights, 34 invariant real parameters, the 5-dimensional zero sector plus two 2-dimensional and sixteen 1-dimensional nonzero sectors, both four-phase coordinate-cut decompositions entrywise (400 entries each), and 320 rank-two 3x3-minor identities. The all-W index implication is a written argument, not proved by those finite checks or a formal kernel.
